hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the one-parameter diagonal family F(k)=M(k,k). The two summands are obtained by substituting k=1 and k=2, respectively.
required_assumptions: k ranges over the two indicated numeric arguments.
hypotheses.rationale: The two terms differ only by replacing both arguments of M with 1 versus 2, so they are points on the diagonal specialization of the same binary form M.
